title: Seasonal Hiring, Elevated Risk: Preparing Facilities for Peak Workforce Surges
summary: Warehouse security strategies for peak season hiring. Learn how to improve access control, screening, safety, and workforce flow.
body_markdown:
As warehouses, distribution centers, and industrial facilities prepare for[peak seasons](https://gotworxstaffing.com/summertime-surge-the-essential-role-of-temporary-staffing-in-warehouses/) , workforce expansion can introduce new operational challenges. Increased volumes of temporary employees, contractors, vendors, and visitors can create bottlenecks at facility entrances, strain security resources, and impact productivity if organizations aren’t prepared.


This practical playbook helps security, operations, and facility leaders evaluate their readiness for seasonal workforce growth. Learn how to identify common access and screening challenges, assess potential gaps before peak hiring begins, build a layered workforce protection strategy, and implement a phased readiness plan to support both safety and operational efficiency. The playbook also explores how[modern screening technology](https://evolv.com/concealed-weapons-detection/) , analytics, and integrated security workflows can help facilities maintain throughput, reduce friction, and protect people without disrupting business operations.


#### You’ll learn:


- Common operational challenges created by seasonal workforce expansion
- Key questions to assess facility readiness before peak season
- Strategies to reduce entry-point bottlenecks and maintain employee flow
- Best practices for building a layered security approach
- A step-by-step framework for planning, testing, and executing a peak-season readiness program
